recipes.name: Iced coffee (Naeng-keopi)
instructions: Combine the coffee, powdered creamer, honey, and the water in a quick shaker.
Cover and shake for about 30 seconds Until mixed well.
Pour into a glass and add the ice cubes. Stir well and serve.
Combine the coffee, powdered creamer, and honey in a glass.
Mix with the hot water with a spoon until well mixed.
Add the cold water and ice cubes. Stir well and serve.

instruction_sections.text: Combine the coffee, powdered creamer, honey, and the water in a quick shaker.
Cover and shake for about 30 seconds Until mixed well.
Pour into a glass and add the ice cubes. Stir well and serve.
How to make iced coffee without a quick shaker:
The ingredients are the same, but instead of 1 cup cold water, use ¼ cup hot water and ¾ cup cold water.
Combine the coffee, powdered creamer, and honey in a glass.
Mix with the hot water with a spoon until well mixed.
Add the cold water and ice cubes. Stir well and serve.
